title: "03-Bounding-Boxes"
output: html_document
---

```{r load packages}
library(dplyr) # A Grammar of Data Manipulation
library(glue) # Interpreted String Literals
library(here) # A Simpler Way to Find Your Files
library(stringr)
library(usethis)
library(sf)
```

Try and create a loop that:
- Parameter that changes from name 1-41
- Loads tracts_df file associated with parameter name
- Calculates its bbox
- Adds that value to a dataframe
- Loop to load new tracts_df file and repeat until all 41 MSA bboxes are in one dataframe object

Read files with the tract data:
```{r}
file_names <- data.frame(object = list.files(path = "intermediate-data-objects/", pattern = "_tracts_df.rda"))
```

Mutate to obtain the name of the city:
```{r}
file_names <- file_names |>
  mutate(city = stringr::str_remove(object, pattern = "_tracts_df.rda"))
```

```{r}
msa_bbox_data <- data.frame(city = character(), xmin = numeric(), ymin = numeric(), xmax = numeric(), ymax = numeric())

msa_bboxes <- st_sfc()

for(i in 1:nrow(file_names)){
  load(glue::glue("intermediate-data-objects/{file_names$object[i]}"))
  city_name <- {file_names$city[i]}
  tracts_bbox <- st_bbox(urban_tracts_df) |>
  st_as_sfc() |>
  st_buffer(dist = 1000) |> # note that the max walk distance in a straight line within 15 minutes at 3.6kmph is 900m
  st_bbox()
  tracts_bbox_df <- as.vector(tracts_bbox)
  msa_bbox_data[i, 1]  <- city_name
  msa_bbox_data[i, 2:5] <- tracts_bbox_df
  msa_bboxes[i] <- st_as_sfc(tracts_bbox)
}

msa_bboxes <- msa_bboxes |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  rename(geometry = x)

msa_bboxes <- cbind(msa_bboxes, msa_bbox_data)
```

```{r}
# Bounding Boxes
save(msa_bboxes, 
     file = glue::glue(here::here(),
                       "/data/msa_bboxes.rda"),
     compress = "bzip2")
```

```{r}
plot(msa_bboxes)
```
